summary: In southern Loch Modan, Mountaineer Gravelgaw calls for help against the Stonesplinter troggs. With dwarven forces committed to the Alliance front, local outposts rely on volunteers to hold the line.

sections.title: A Thin Defense
sections.body: The Mountaineers guarding the southern pass into Dun Morogh are stretched thin. King Magni Bronzebeard has sent much of Ironforge's strength to the wider Alliance front, leaving the Valley of Kings towers short of regular infantry. So Mountaineer Gravelgaw calls on volunteers to strike Stonesplinter Valley and keep the troggs at bay. Reinforcements may never come.

sections.title: Stonesplinter Shamans and Brawlers
sections.body: The Stonesplinter troggs are neither mindless nor aimless. Their war bands fight with brute force and crude elemental magic. Gravelgaw wants their veteran Skullthumpers and their Seers, who lead with mystic power, driven from the fight. Without those leaders, the tribe's southern camps lose their order and cannot mass against the Ironforge road.

sections.title: Grim Tidings from the Front
sections.body: When you report back, Gravelgaw has grim news. The promised dwarven reinforcements are not coming. Heavy losses on the distant Alliance front have drained Ironforge's reserves, leaving local Mountaineers and passing sellswords to defend Loch Modan.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Gravelgaw is at the southern guard tower along the road through the Valley of Kings. He guards the pass between Loch Modan and Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why are the dwarven Mountaineers so undermanned?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard has sent most of Ironforge's standing military to the wider Alliance front. As losses mount there, Loch Modan's border posts are left with skeleton crews and must rely on passing volunteers.

faq.q: Where can the Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and Seers be found?
faq.answer: The Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and Seers gather mainly in the southern camps of Stonesplinter Valley, east of the Valley of Kings. Some also haunt the northernmost island in The Loch.

faq.q: Why target Skullthumpers and Seers specifically?
faq.answer: Skullthumpers are the Stonesplinter tribe's shock troops, while Seers wield crude magic and direct the lesser troggs. Defeating both takes away the tribe's force and coordination.

faq.q: Where does Gravelgaw send you next?
aliases: after defense of the king's lands
faq.answer: Gravelgaw sends you to Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower of the Valley of Kings, to help with the valley's defense.

angles.text: As a dwarf, defending the Valley of Kings is personal. It honors Ironforge's greatest rulers, and troggs defile that ground while your kin bleed on distant battlefields. It is a bitter pill to swallow.
This mission shows the cost of the wider Alliance war. While its forces secure distant lands, the homelands of its own members are left vulnerable to local threats.
